title: Fluffy Pancakes
desc: Soft, thick pancakes with a lightly golden crust.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk and melted butter separately; fold into the dry ingredients just until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with a little of the oil.
Cook small ladlefuls for 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear; flip and cook for 1–2 minutes until the centres are set. Repeat with remaining batter and oil.

title: Belgian Waffles
desc: Crisp waffles with an airy centre, made in a waffle iron.
steps: Preheat the waffle iron. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Separate the eggs. Whisk yolks with milk, melted butter and vanilla, then stir into the flour mixture.
Whisk the whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter.
Brush the iron with oil and cook portions according to its instructions, usually 4–6 minutes, until golden and cooked through.

title: French Toast
desc: Egg-soaked bread fried gently until golden.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Dip bread into the mixture briefly on both sides; let it absorb without falling apart.
Melt some butter in a frying pan over medium-low heat.
Fry in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and the egg mixture is fully set; use remaining butter as needed.

title: Crêpes
desc: Thin, flexible pancakes for sweet or savoury fillings.
steps: Whisk flour, salt, eggs and half the milk into a smooth batter.
Whisk in the remaining milk and melted butter. Rest for 20 minutes.
Heat a shallow non-stick pan over medium heat and brush lightly with oil.
Swirl a thin layer of batter across the pan. Cook for 1 minute, turn and cook for 30 seconds; repeat with remaining batter and oil.

title: Shakshuka
desc: Eggs gently cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Soften onion and pepper in olive oil in a wide lidded frying pan for 10 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli; stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and salt; simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until thick.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook gently for 6–10 minutes until whites and yolks are set; scatter with parsley.

title: Scrambled Eggs
desc: Soft scrambled eggs cooked slowly in butter.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk and salt until evenly mixed.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Add eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, scraping the base, for 5–7 minutes.
Remove when the curds are set with no liquid egg remaining. Add chives and serve immediately.

title: Poached Eggs
desc: Gently poached pasteurised eggs with tender whites.
steps: Bring water and vinegar to a very gentle simmer in a wide saucepan.
Crack each pasteurised egg into a small cup.
Slide eggs into the water, leaving space between them. Poach for 3–4 minutes until the whites are set; cook longer for firm yolks.
Lift out with a slotted spoon, drain well and serve straight away.

title: Eggs Benedict
desc: Toasted muffins, ham and poached eggs with hollandaise.
steps: Split and toast the muffins. Warm the ham in a dry frying pan.
Bring water and vinegar to a gentle simmer. Crack each pasteurised egg into a cup and slide into the water in batches.
Poach for 3–4 minutes until whites are set, longer for firm yolks; drain with a slotted spoon.
Top each muffin half with ham and an egg. Spoon over warm prepared hollandaise and serve immediately.

title: Overnight Oats
desc: Oats and chia softened overnight with milk and yoghurt.
steps: Mix oats, milk, yoghurt, chia seeds and honey in a bowl.
Divide between covered jars or containers.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours so the oats and seeds soften.
Stir before serving and top with berries; eat within 2 days.

title: Granola
desc: Toasted oats, nuts and seeds with maple syrup.
steps: Preheat to 150°C fan and line a large baking tray.
Mix oats, nuts, seeds, cinnamon and salt. Stir in maple syrup and oil.
Spread in a thin layer and bake for 25–30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Cool completely on the tray, then stir in cranberries and store airtight.

title: Breakfast Burrito
desc: Egg, bean and cheese wraps for a filling breakfast.
steps: Soften pepper in oil for 5 minutes. Add black beans and heat until steaming.
Whisk eggs with salt, add to the pan and stir gently until fully set.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan. Divide the filling between them and add Cheddar and tomato.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly; toast seam-side down for 1 minute and serve.

title: Potato & Egg Hash
desc: Golden potatoes, peppers and eggs cooked in one pan after parboiling.
steps: Cover potatoes with water, bring to a boil and simmer for 8 minutes until nearly tender; drain and let steam dry.
Heat oil in a wide frying pan and brown potatoes for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Add onion, pepper, paprika and salt; cook for 8 minutes until softened.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook gently for 6–10 minutes until whites and yolks are set. Finish with parsley.
